title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Developer - Money Movement)
searchText: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Developer - Money Movement)  Coinbase Careers Page Ready to be pushed beyond what you think you’re capable of? At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom in the world. It’s a massive, ambitious opportunity that demands the best of us, every day, as we build the emerging onchain platform — and with it, the future global financial system. To achieve our mission, we’re seeking a very specific candidate. We want someone who is passionate about our mission and who believes in the power of crypto and blockchain technology to update the financial system. We want someone who is eager to leave their mark on the world, who relishes the pressure and privilege of working with high caliber colleagues, and who actively seeks feedback to keep leveling up. We want someone who will run towards, not away from, solving the company’s hardest problems. Our work culture is intense and isn’t for everyone. But if you want to build the future alongside others who excel in their disciplines and expect the same from you, there’s no better place to be. While many roles at Coinbase are remote-first, we are not remote-only. In-person participation is required throughout the year. Team and company-wide offsites are held multiple times annually to foster collaboration, connection, and alignment. Attendance is expected and fully supported. Join the Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) Money Movement team and help build the infrastructure powering the future of global finance. CDP brings together payments, trading, wallets, and stablecoins through a single onboarding flow and self-service APIs. Our mission is to make it easy for businesses to embed crypto-native financial capabilities into their products — securely, reliably, and at global scale. On the Money Movement team, we’re building the core infrastructure for stablecoin-based payments, enabling fast, secure, and scalable transfers across borders and platforms. This work underpins how value moves across the Coinbase ecosystem and beyond. What you’ll be doing: Design, build, and maintain backend systems and infrastructure that power stablecoin pay-ins, payouts, deposits, and withdrawals. Serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for key projects, driving them from design to production with high accountability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including product, design, infrastructure, and compliance—to deliver robust and scalable solutions. Work closely with teams across Coinbase (e.g., CDP Payments API, Onramp APIs, CoinBiz) to integrate stablecoin functionality into core products. Help build internal and external APIs that make it easy for businesses and partners to leverage stablecoin-powered money movement. Identify and address performance, scalability, and reliability challenges across systems. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a strong, inclusive, and high-performing engineering culture. Stay up to date on the evolving crypto ecosystem, identifying opportunities to improve utility, adoption, and innovation in stablecoin infrastructure. What we look for in you: Minimum 5 years of experience in software engineering. Proven experience building and operating large-scale backend systems, ideally in fintech, payments, or crypto. Strong proficiency in backend technologies (e.g., Go, Java, or similar) and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP). Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and system design. Experience working with crypto or blockchain technologies is a strong plus—but not required. A product-minded approach to engineering—you care about the “why” behind what you build. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects end-to-end as a DRI. Collaborative spirit and ability to work cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering teams. Enthusiasm for building foundational technology in a fast-moving, high-impact space. Why This Role Matters Stablecoins are becoming a core primitive for global payments. In this role, you’ll help define how businesses of all sizes move money instantly and securely — shaping real-world financial infrastructure at massive scale. Nice to haves: Prior experience working with stablecoins, DeFi protocols, or on-chain payments. Familiarity with smart contract platforms (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Base) and related developer tools. Contributions to open-source crypto or blockchain projects. Experience building multi-chain or cross-chain applications. Knowledge of regulatory or compliance considerations in crypto payments. Interest in or experience with tokenomics, financial primitives, or digital asset infrastructure. Previous experience in a startup or hyper-growth environment where you had to wear multiple hat Job #: P70177 Pay Transparency Notice: Depending on your work location, the target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, vision and 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $186,065 — $218,900 USD Please be advised that each candidate may submit a maximum of four applications within any 30-day period. We encourage you to carefully evaluate how your skills and interests align with Coinbase's roles before applying. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Coinbase is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law. Coinbase will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. For US applicants, you may view the Employee Rights and the Know Your Rights notices by clicking on their corresponding links. Additionally, Coinbase participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Coinbase is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please contact us at accommodations[at]coinbase.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. For quick access to screen reading technology compatible with this site click here to download a free compatible screen reader (free step by step tutorial can be found here) . Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available here . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. For US applicants only, by submitting your application you are agreeing to arbitration of disputes as outlined here. AI Disclosure For select roles, Coinbase is piloting an AI tool based on machine learning technologies to conduct initial screening interviews to qualified applicants. The tool simulates realistic interview scenarios and engages in dynamic conversation. A human recruiter will review your interview responses, provided in the form of a voice recording and/or transcript, to assess them against the qualifications and characteristics outlined in the job description. For select roles, Coinbase is also piloting an AI interview intelligence platform to transcribe and summarize interview notes, allowing our interviewers to fully focus on you as the candidate. The above pilots are for testing purposes and Coinbase will not use AI to make decisions impacting employment . To request a reasonable accommodation due to disability, please contact accommodations[at]coinbase.com Ready to be pushed beyond what you think you’re capable of?
